Hunter.description: Emulates specialized techniques for taking down specific types of dangerous monsters and groups of foes.

3.name: Hunter's Prey
3.tldr: Choose a tactical option to enhance your attacks: Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer, or Horde Breaker.

7.name: Defensive Tactics
7.tldr: Choose a defensive option: Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense, or Steel Will.

11.name: Multiattack
11.tldr: Gain a sweeping multiattack option: Volley (ranged) or Whirlwind Attack (melee).

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
15.tldr: Choose an advanced defensive technique: Evasion, Stand Against the Tide, or Uncanny Dodge.

Beast Master.description: Bonds with a loyal animal companion to fight side-by-side in the wild.

3.name: Ranger's Companion
3.tldr: Gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and fights under your command.

7.name: Exceptional Training
7.tldr: Command your beast companion to take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action as a bonus action.

11.name: Bestial Fury
11.tldr: Your beast companion can make two attacks when you command it to take the Attack action.

15.name: Share Spells
15.tldr: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your beast companion if it is within 30 feet.
